In [[geometry]], a '''rotunda''' is any member of a family of [[Cyclic group|cyclic-symmetric]] [[polyhedra]]. They are similar to a [[Cupola (geometry)|cupola]] but, instead of alternating squares and triangles, they alternate pentagons and triangles around an axis. The [[pentagonal rotunda]] is a [[Johnson solid]].

Other forms can be generated with dihedral symmetry and distorted equilateral pentagons.
